notes: Datasheet SLVS543S covers TL431/TL432 in C/I/Q temperature grades and base/A/B accuracy grades (tables 6.5-6.13); only the base-accuracy TL431C table 6.5 (page 6) is included. Reference package is DBZ SOT-23-3: pin table DBZ column gives CATHODE 1, REF 2, ANODE 3, matching the DBZ (SOT-23-3) diagram. For LP (TO-92) the pin table column gives CATHODE 1, ANODE 2, REF 3. Pin table TYPE column: CATHODE 'I/O', REF 'I', ANODE 'O' (ANODE typed 'O' by TI although it is the common/ground pin) -> stored as GROUND. VI(dev) has two rows: 'SOT23-3 and TL432 devices' (6/16 mV, applies to the DBZ reference package) and 'All other devices' (4/25 mV). ΔVref/ΔVKA values printed negative (typ –1.4, max –2.7). ABS_MAX 'Continuos' typo kept verbatim. RECOMMENDED VKA min is the expression 'Vref' -> null. Thermal table has only RθJA and RθJC(top). No tabulated timing/dynamic specs exist (only typical Figure 6-14 'Pulse Response' curve with f = 100 kHz test circuit), so timing is empty; |ZKA| at f ≤ 1kHz is a small-signal impedance spec, kept in ELECTRICAL.
